summary: Iteration 4 — validated new session features: guest chat, attachment gating, image quota fields, PayPal Luchii Pro upgrade plan, profile upgrade card, sessions sidebar. Backend: 31/31 pytest passed. Frontend: chat loads for guest, guest sidebar visible, guest can send/receive message, Image Creator selection shows toast (no crash), admin login->sessions sidebar renders, /profile upgrade card shows pro-active for admin. CRITICAL: frontend was broken with a JSX parse error on ChatDemo.jsx (orphan JSX after function close) — patched so app compiles. Two required data-testids ('chat-guest-banner' and 'chat-voice-toggle') are NOT implemented in ChatDemo.jsx.

ui_bugs.issue: File had a JSX parse error (orphan <Lock/> block after the component's closing brace, lines 396-414). Webpack failed with 'Adjacent JSX elements must be wrapped in an enclosing tag'. Removed the dead code so the app compiles. Root cause: incomplete refactor when replacing the old guest-lock overlay with the new guest-banner — old markup left behind.
Required data-testid 'chat-guest-banner' is MISSING. Spec calls for a guest banner in the chat widget; no such element is rendered. voiceOn state exists in ChatDemo but no banner JSX exists.

Required data-testid 'chat-voice-toggle' is MISSING for signed-in users. voiceOn/toggleVoice state is defined but no toggle button is rendered anywhere in the header. Auto-speak-after-stream code path exists (line 242) but user can never turn it on/off via UI.

integration_issues.issue: Works correctly — shows red toast 'Sign up free to use the Image & Video Creators' and no crash. VERIFIED.

action_items: Add the missing chat-voice-toggle button in the ChatDemo header (only render when `user` is truthy). Wire it to toggleVoice/voiceOn.
Add the missing chat-guest-banner element in ChatDemo (render when !user). It should include the sign-up CTA text.
Do NOT re-introduce the orphan Lock overlay JSX that was removed — the new guest UX is: guest can chat freely (banner + sidebar card), so no lock overlay is needed.
Consider: pin CI/lint step in the frontend pipeline so a parse error like this fails the build before it ships.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/chat now uses optional_user — guests are correctly allowed (no auth required); attachment_base64 still triggers 401 for guests — verified via test_chat_attachment_requires_auth.
server.py IMAGE_LIMIT_FREE=20 / IMAGE_LIMIT_PRO=200 enforced; response now returns images_used_today and daily_limit — verified for both admin (limit=200) and fresh free user (limit=20).

PayPal upgrade plan luchii-pro at $15.00 is exposed under upgrade_plans; POST /api/paypal/orders {plan_id:'luchii-pro'} requires auth (401 without cookie) and returns a real order id when authed — verified with admin session (no capture invoked).
server.py is now 828 lines — still over the 700 line soft threshold; split into routers (auth, chat, image/voice, paypal, keys) recommended.
ChatDemo.jsx contained committed-broken code that would have blocked the entire frontend from loading in production — needs stricter lint/CI gating.
Missing UI (voice toggle, guest banner) suggests the ChatDemo edit was not completed in this session even though the state/effect for auto-speak was wired up.
